text: Urad Kohli's greatest chase was in the 82 not out at the MCG. It was 183 in Mirpaul. Now I know what you are thinking, nothing beats that night against Pakistan in Melbourne right? But hear me out.
Asia Cup, Mirpur, India vs Pakistan. Pakistan smash 3
29 200s from happis and naseel jamished back then chasing 330 against Pakistan felt almost impossible
and it got worse, Kambi was gone for a duck, India was 0 for 1 and in walked a 23 year old Virat Kohli.

He did not panic. He batted alongside Sachin Tendulkar in one of Sachin's last ODIs and then built a massive partnership with Ruchharma. Umar Ghol Sai Dajmal Shahid Afrid he took all of them on 22 forwards and the faster the asking rate went up the
Umar Ghul's Sayyid Ajmal Shahid Afrid he took all of them on 22 force and the faster the asking rate went up the calmer he caught
183 of 148 balls. His highest ever ODI score. India chased it down with 13 balls to his pair.
For me the mcg was pure magic but mirpur was there the chaise master was born. So 183 mirpur or 82 not out at the mcg which one gets your vote comment below and follow for more
